crew.overview: Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, earth's survivors take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes who now stand as earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.
crew.title: Pacific Rim

crew.overview: Ten years after the events of the original, a reprogrammed T-800 is sent back in time to protect young John Connor from the shape-shifting T-1000. Together with his mother Sarah, he fights to stop Skynet from triggering a nuclear apocalypse.
crew.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

details.biography: Dustin Bernard was born in Los Angeles, California, USA. Dustin is a production manager and producer, known for Pacific Rim (2013), The Fugitive (1993) and Suicide Squad (2016).
details.name: Dustin Bernard
